newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sungei Way falls on Gopeng stake buy.
newsitem.headline: Sungei Way falls on Gopeng stake buy.

text.p: The stock of Malaysian construction firm Sungei Way Holdings Bhd fell in heavy volume on Friday as the company's acquisition of a stake in Gopeng Bhd was viewed negatively, analysts said.
Around 0745 GMT, the stock was down 38 cents or 7.7 percent to 4.56 ringgit on volume of 5.6 million shares.
The stock had earlier fallen to a 12-month low of 4.44 ringgit.
"They have overpaid for Gopeng. From a businessman's point of view it may be strategic. But investors don't like it," said an analyst at a foreign brokerage.
Sungei Way announced on Tuesday it had acquired a 22.7 percent stake in Gopeng for 22.93 million ringgit or 5.49 ringgit a share.
Analysts said the purchase may have been done as a means of getting a stake in the cement plant of Perak Hanjoong Simen Sdn Bhd, a 45 percent associate of Gopeng.
Gopeng stock was at 4.84 ringgit, down 2.0 cents on volume of 46,000 shares.
